criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 7, 1, 6 and 8 are strong reliefs; 7 meets the showstopper test, 1 nearly. Frames 4 and 5 are bar charts on a brushed plate with a dead band on 5 and an unexplained terrace stub on 4. Frames 2 and 3 are a grid of identical rectangles whose sections sit in a sticker-like halo stroke, with mid grey label ends as the brightest mass. Frame 9's label end reads as a grey card with five grooves, its aperture light is faint.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key, one grade, one dark register, ember reserved for T cells. Three continuity devices work. Frames 2 to 5 are four consecutive frames of cold grey hardware, and all nine share one skeleton, so the declared rotation is not visible on the sheet.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn counts match. Hedges are kept. Frame 9's kicker 'Co-lead Linghua Wang' states the release's description as fact, traceable to c11 and looser than its source.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened and who did it are clear. No place, no public body, no next step; the Texas stake is a funder name.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe. Frame 2 pays the method, 4 and 5 spend two frames on one range, the turn at 7 lands and 8 pays it off. The close lands softly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good plain headlines. 'Drawn to illustrate.' reads as a stamp, nothing sounds like Texas, frame 5's dek is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A real departure from nos. 50 to 52: orthographic material relief, plum, oxblood and ember, a macro tissue opening. The skeleton is familiar.

defects_ranked: Frames 2 to 5 sit outside the tissue world.
Frames 4 and 5 are charts; either could be cut.
Frames 2 and 3 sections have sticker outlines and mid grey label ends.
Frame 9's kicker states the release's description as fact.
No Texas place, body or next step.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bevelled grey bar chart on a brushed plate with a dead band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Draw the three tracks as rows of ember T cell beads in carved plum stroma channels at one pitch (1, 4 and 21), raise the relief's top edge to the dek's foot.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The same chart on tick rows, the grey unit block the brightest mass, an unexplained terrace stub.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Merge into frame 5, or rebuild as the same bead-channel relief, and delete the terrace stub.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Identical rectangles, sections as speckle inside a halo stroke, label ends the brightest mass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model each section with the cover's Voronoi nest relief at slide scale, delete the halo, and make the label ends frosted glass near L* 75.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Same as 2, and the pool where the count ends doesn't register at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Same repair as 2, an ember accent on the 37th section and a visible pool on the bare bench after it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The label end reads as an icon, the aperture light is faint, the section has a halo glow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lift the label to frosted L* 70 to 80, give the aperture a bright upper-left crescent rim, remove the section's halo glow.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 2 to 5 in the tissue's own materials instead of grey hardware and merge the benchmark into one frame.
